solutions.title: Brute force pair scan
solutions.strategy: Try every buy day and every later sell day.

timeComplexity.explanation: For each index, the algorithm scans all later indices, creating a quadratic number of buy/sell comparisons.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only loop counters and the best profit are stored regardless of input length.

solutions.title: One-pass minimum price
solutions.strategy: Keep the cheapest price seen before the current day and update the best sale profit.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each price is visited once and contributes constant work.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The running minimum and best profit are scalar values.
